{{Quote|The Rebellion has resisted more firmly than anticipated in the Farrfin and Dolomar sectors.|[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gilad Pellaeon/Legends|Pellaeon]]|<ref name="TLC" />}}
The '''Dolomar sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Balfron/Legends|Balfron]], [[Caprioril]], [[Dolomar]], [[Kamparas]], [[Pantolomin/Legends|Pantolomin]], [[Phorliss]] and [[Wor Tandell/Legends|Wor Tandell]].

==History==
The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] transferred the capital of the sector from [[Dolomar]] to [[Caprioril]].<ref name="TCSWE" />

Both the Dolomar and [[Farrfin sector/Legends|Farrfin sector]] were major targets of [[Thrawn campaign|offensives]] by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]. The sectors were heavily defended by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] personally made a tour of the defenses in these areas.<ref name="TCSWE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Ketaris/Legends|Ketaris]], [[Sarka/Legends|Sarka]], and [[Omwat/Legends|Omwat]] in the Dolomar Sector. Ketaris and Omwat are in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]; Sarka is in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].
